summary: This directory manages the application-wide logging infrastructure, providing a unified interface for recording events and facilitating diagnostic output across different system components and operational modes.
responsibilities: Defining the standard interface for system-wide logging
Managing the lifecycle and assignment of the active logger instance
Providing utilities for diagnostic output such as object state comparison
Configuring specialized logging for specific functional domains
relationships: The logger interface dictates the contract for all logging operations across the system.
The logger proxy delegates log requests to the currently configured logger instance.
Diagnostic utilities utilize the active logger instance to surface information during debug sessions.
designDecisions: Use of an interface to decouple the logging API from specific implementations
Proxy pattern for dynamic logger instance management
Centralized configuration of log behavior via global setup functions
